notes_for_editor: Record is a lookout, but every source describes only a camp c.1930; the design value should not be read as a tower. Gone status comes from two directories; no source gives a removal date or describes remains. Access 'hike-in' is from Idaho Fire Lookouts only. The Bitterroot Star item is an opinion column about the wider area, not the site. Two searches found no Forest Service inventory entry for the site. Brief county 'Idaho' corrected to 'Idaho County'.
